(PER: THE HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE S G PANDIT)

The appellants are the legal representatives of the deceased Sri.Venkatesh who died in a Motor Vehicle accident that took place on 07.08.2020 between Toyoto Etios car bearing No.KA-22/C-8941 and Eitcher Goods vehicle bearing No.MH-14/EM-0305.
2.
The appellants filed claim petition under Section 166 of the Motor vehicles Act, 1988, (Hereinafter for short 'M.V.Act') claiming compensation for the death of Sri.Venkatesh.
Claimants are the parents and sister of the deceased.
It is stated that the deceased was working at Tata Consultancy Services at Bengaluru and was drawing salary of Rs.43,350/- per month.
On issuance of notice to the respondents, the respondents appeared and respondent No.2 filed his objection raising various contentions.

3. Before the Tribunal, on behalf of the appellants, first claimant-mother of the deceased examined herself as PW1 and marked exhibits P1 to P23 and exhibits P24, P25 NC: 2025:KHC-D:13645-DB HC-KAR and P26 were marked with consent.
On behalf of the respondents, exhibits R1 to R11 were marked.

The Tribunal on consideration of the material on record awarded total compensation of Rs.63,36,464/- on the following heads:-
Loss of Rs.44,01,300/-
dependency +17,60,520/-(Loss of Rs.61,61,820/-
 future prospects)
Medical Expenses Rs. 24,644/-
Transportation of dead body and funeral Rs. 15,000/-
expenses Loss of estate Rs. 15,000/-
Filial consortium towards petitioner Nos.1 to 3 Rs. 1,20,000/-
 4.

Not being satisfied with the quantum of Smt. Padmaja W/O Ashok Patil vs K P Transport Pvt Ltd on 8 October, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/40204782/
3 compensation awarded by the Tribunal, the claimants are in appeal.

sentences.text:
5. Heard learned counsel Sri.Santhosh B. Rawoot, for appellants and learned counsel Sri.S.S.Koliwad for respondent Nos.2 and 4 and perused the entire appeal papers.
6.

Learned counsel Sri.Santhosh B. Rawoot appearing for appellants would submit that the appellants would restrict their claim only towards the escalation of the NC: 2025:KHC-D:13645-DB HC-KAR compensation awarded on the head of consortium as per National Insurance Company Limited Vs. Pranay Sethi & others1.

entities.text: National Insurance Company Limited Vs. Pranay Sethi & others1
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel would submit that in terms of the Pranay Sethi's case, the appellants would be entitled for enhancement at the rate of 10% for every three years on the compensation awarded on conventional heads.
Therefore, learned counsel would pray for enhanced compensation of 10% for every 3 years on the conventional heads as well as on consortium awarded by the Tribunal.
7. Per contra, learned counsel Sri.S.S.Koliwad is not in a position to dispute the legal position laid by the Hon'ble Apex Court in the case of Pranay Sethi (supra).
8. In the present case, the accident is not in dispute and the award in respect of loss of dependency and medical expenses is also not in dispute.

Only dispute raised by the appellants is that as per law laid down by the Hon'ble Apex Court in the case of Pranay Sethi, 10% enhancement 2017 ACJ 2700 NC: 2025:KHC-D:13645-DB HC-KAR every three years is not awarded by the Tribunal on the compensation granted on the conventional heads as well as under the head consortium.
9. The Hon'ble Apex Court in the case of Pranay Sethi supra has made it clear that the compensation awarded on the conventional heads shall be enhanced at the rate of 10% for every three years.

In the instant case, in view of the principles of law laid down in the above decision, the appellants would be entitled for enhanced amount at the rate of 10% on the compensation awarded on the heads transportation of dead body and funeral expenses, loss of estate and on the head of consortium.

The claimants would be entitled for the following enhanced compensation in addition to the compensation awarded on the following heads:-
Under the head Rs.1,500-00 transportation of dead body and funeral expenses Loss of estate Rs.1,500-00 Filial Consortium towards Rs.12,000-00  Total Rs.15,000-00  NC: 2025:KHC-D:13645-DB HC-KAR Smt. Padmaja W/O Ashok Patil vs K P Transport Pvt Ltd on 8 October, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/40204782/
4 10.

With the above, the appeal stands disposed off.
